test_interpolate_face_attributes_python: test the python interpolate_face_attributes_python function with barycentric coordinates and face attributes on CUDA
test_interpolate_face_attributes_cuda: test the CUDA interpolate_face_attributes function with barycentric coordinates and face attributes on GPU
test_python_vs_cuda_interpolation: test that python and CUDA interpolate_face_attributes produce matching forward and backward gradients
test_interpolate_attributes_with_meshes: test interpolate_face_attributes using Meshes, TexturesVertex, and Fragments to compute interpolated texel values
test_interpolate_attributes_gradient: test backward gradient propagation through interpolate_face_attributes on vertex texture features
